item.title: TableSprint Launches AI-based GTM Agent ‘Fernor’ For Sales Automation »
item.description: TableSprint has launched “Fernor”, an artificial intelligence (AI)-based go-to-market (GTM) agent aimed at helping businesses automate customer engagement, lead management, and outbound sales processes.

item.title: C5i To Acquire UK-based Datavid; Deal To Bolster Graph Data Capabilities For AI Systems »
item.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and analytics firm C5i has signed an agreement to acquire UK-based data and AI company Datavid, a move that underscores the growing importance of graph data and semantic technologies in enterprise artificial intelligence deployments.

item.title: SAP Labs India, SRH University Sign MoU To Expand Digital Skills Collaboration »
item.description: SAP Labs India and Germany-based SRH University have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to expand their academic collaboration to India, with a focus on integrating industry-oriented digital skills into higher education programmes.

item.title: Tata Power-DDL To Hold National Lok Adalat On March 22 For Settlement Of Power Theft, Disconnection Cases »
item.description: Tata Power Delhi Distribution Limited (Tata Power-DDL), a leading power utility supplying electricity to a populace of around 9 million in North Delhi, is participating in ‘National Lok Adalat’ for the on-the-spot settlement of electricity theft cases and disconnected connections.

item.title: CRED Gets RBI Nod To Operate As Payment Aggregator »
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has granted final authorisation to fintech firm CRED to operate as a Payment Aggregator (PA), allowing it to onboard merchants and facilitate digital payment transactions under the regulator’s supervision.

item.title: Akamai Introduces New AI Features To Its Security Suite »
item.description: US-based cybersecurity firm Akamai on Wednesday announced new artificial intelligence (AI)-driven capabilities for its Guardicore Segmentation solution, aimed at strengthening Zero Trust security frameworks and helping organisations respond to increasingly sophisticated cyber threats.

item.title: Former Defence Secretary Giridhar Aramane Joins AXISCADES Board As Independent Director »
item.description: Engineering and technology solutions firm AXISCADES Technologies has appointed former Defence Secretary Giridhar Aramane as a Non-Executive Independent Director on its board.

item.title: Lakshya AMC Gets SEBI Nod For Foray Into Mutual Fund Business »
